spans.s:
अवृक अ-वृक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. not hurting,
inoffensive, true; unendangered, safe; free from one
who obscures; (अम्), n. safety, peace; quiet.

अवृक्ष अ-वृक्ष or अ-वृक्षक, अस्, आ, अम्,
treeless; destitute of trees.

अवृजिन अ-वृजिन, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. not
intriguing, straightforward, sincere, not deserting
(friends), an epithet of the Ādityas.

अवृत अ-वृत, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. unchecked,
unimpeded; unsubdued; unselected; uncovered, un-
protected.

आ-वृत, अस्, आ, अम्, enclosed, encompassed, sur-
rounded (by a ditch, wall, &c.); covered, screened, con-
cealed; invested, involved; spread, overspread, over-
cast; filled with, abounding with; (अस्), m. a man of
mixed origin, the son of a Brāhman by a woman of
the Ugra caste.

आ-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, turned round, stirred, whirled;
reverted, averted; retreated, fled.

अवृत्ति अ-वृत्ति, इस्, f. inadequate support,
absence of subsistence or allowance; want; (इस्, इस्, इ),
not existing, not present.
—अवृत्ति-त्व, अम्, n. non-
existence.
आ-वृति, इस्, f. covering, enclosing, hiding.

आ-वृत्ति, इस्, f. turning towards, entering, turning
back or from, reversion, retreat, flight; recurrence to
the same point; repetition; turn of a way, course,
direction; occurrence; revolving, going round; worldly
existence, the revolution of births; use, employment,
application.
—आवृत्ति-दीपक, अम्, n. (in rhetoric)
laying stress upon a word by repeating it.

अवृथा अ-वृथा, ind. not in vain, success-
fully, profitably.
—अवृथार्थ (˚था-अर्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
successful, gaining one's object.

अवृद्धिक अ-वृद्धिक, अस्, ई, अम् (rt. वृध्),
not augmentative; not bearing interest.

अ-वृध, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. not promoting, not
honouring.

अवृष्टि अ-वृष्टि, इस्, f. want of rain, drought;
famine.
आ-वृष्टि, इस्, f. raining, pouring.

अवृह अ-वृह or अ-बृह, आस्, m. pl. (rt.
वृह्), a class of Buddhist divinities.
अ-वृहित, अस्, आ, अम्, few, not much or large.

आवृ आ-वृ, cl. 5. 9. P. A. -वृणोति, -वृणुते,
वृणाति, -णीते, -वरितुम् or -रीतुम्, to choose, de-
sire; to cover, hide, conceal; fill, surround; to enclose,
comprehend, shut, hem in; to keep off: Caus. P.
-वारयति, -यितुम्, to cover, enclose, ward off, keep
off.

आवृज् आ-वृज्, cl. 1. A. -वर्जते, -जितुम्, to
bestow, give: Caus. P. -वर्जयति, -यितुम्, to turn
over, incline, bend, pour out, to cause to yield, over-
come.

आवृत् 1. आ-वृत्, cl. 1. A. -वर्तते, -तितुम्,
to turn or go towards, to turn round, turn back,
revolve, return: Caus. P. -वर्तयति, -यितुम्, to
cause to turn; to roll; to cause to roll down, shed;
to attract; A. -वर्तयते, to turn round or back.

2. आ-वृत्, त्, f. turning towards or round, entering;
(Sāy.) causing to turn towards; turn of a path or
way, course, process, direction; progress of an action,
occurrence, a series of actions, order, method.
—आवृत्-
वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. turned or turning towards.
आ-वृत्य, ind. having turned, turning towards.

आवृध् आ-वृध्, cl. 1. A. -वर्धते, -धितुम्,
to increase.

आवृष् आ-वृष्, cl. 1. P. A., Ved. -वर्षति,
-ते, -षितुम्, to rain, to pour out (a libation).
